answer: Idle forfeiture charges every fake key for sitting unused. Each key posts a 20 POA bond, and a key with no attestation across a 3-epoch voyage loses 5 POA of it to the burn address, no refund. Only keys with a live bond earn emission, so parking is a loss. A farm holding a nebula of dormant keys to wait for a crystal-clear strike window forfeits the whole bond in 12 epochs. 1,000 fakes x 20 POA = 20,000 POA the attacker pays, burned.
